A sequence has 3 terms.
The multiplication of the inside pair is the middle number squared.
Example
The sequence is 1 2 3
Product of inside pair 2 # 2 = 2 = 4
Product of outside pair 1 # 3 = 3
Product difference 4 - 3 = 1
